headline: Is my energy blocking my money?
note:
FRAME: money — the strictest guard on the funnel. No amount, no date, no source, no financial advice, never blames her, never 'too late', never presumes she is broke.

🔴 Beat 4 says the money has not LANDED or not STAYED — never that she has none.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

FINDING: 'her energy is not the block' — beat 3a 'your energy isn't wrong', beat 3c 'yours is still fresh'.

🔴 PRE-FLIGHT STEP 3 FIRES HARDEST HERE. The ad blames her outright, so every card has to open on the same 'no'. The three affirmations are deliberately different SHAPES, not different words: 'your energy isn't wrong' · 'nothing in you has gone sour' · 'yours is still fresh'.

⛔ No mindset blame, no vibration, no 'you attract', no self-sabotage — the guard bans all four and they are what this headline pulls for.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through, and your hand found the busiest of the three.
Look at his hands. One raised, one down, and both of them working.
You asked if your energy is blocking your money. What catches me is that both of those hands are moving.
And yet it hasn't landed. And you've come in blaming yourself for that.
Something stands in the gap between you and it. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing that…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave nothing away, and you found the calmest man in the deck.
He hangs by one ankle, upside down. Look at his face, though — it's calm.
You asked if your energy is blocking your money. So much of this picture is being held — that's what I keep coming back to.
Still, it hasn't come through. And the reason you're offering me is you.
Something arrives at the point where money would come in. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. Gold, with not one cloud across it.
You asked if your energy is blocking your money. Open daylight, and a step already under way.
But it hasn't landed. And you're still the one asking what's wrong with yours.
The hold here is light, and it stays where it is. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
